summary: Sealed-bid envelope feature (bid_seal.py, bid_opening.py, bids.py gates, uploads.py sealed files, BidOpeningPanel UI). Backend: new tests/test_v64_sealed_bids.py 29/29 PASS. It covers: bids stored with price/notes=None plus a Fernet `sealed` sub-doc and seal_v=1. The vendor's create, GET /mine, GET /{id} and PATCH all return plaintext, and PATCH re-seals the notes. Staff (admin, reviewer, accounting, committee_member) get documents=[], price/notes None, envelope_state=sealed and sealed_documents_count=2 on both /bids/admin/{id} and /bids?notice_ref; name, vendor, submitted_at, status and EMD fields are still present. bid.viewed audit is recorded. bid-docs upload is anonymous->401, stored encrypted with sealed=True and owner_vendor_id. File access: owner 200 with the original bytes, other vendor 403, admin 403, anonymous 401, public-files 403. Bundle: admin 404 (all skipped), owner 200 zip. Gates: technical-clear 412, financial-open 412, admin flag / certifier / accounting accept 412, escrow_agent accept from emd_paid works before opening. Opening: no committee -> blocker; before deadline 412; non-member 403; bad stage 422; opening date in the future 412; commercial before technical 412; partial approval keeps bids sealed; double approval 409. When all members approve, only the EMD-confirmed bid is unsealed (the emd_pending bid stays sealed) and bid_opening.technical_opened is audited. After that, admin gets the tech file 200 and the commercial file 403. technical-clear then works, accounting is still 412, and commercial opening unseals the price for the tech-cleared bid only. UI was checked as committee@ (admin role) on /admin/bids/:id: sealed banner, 'Sealed until opening', BidOpeningPanel, approve button, the 'Approval recorded — 1 member(s) still to approve' toast and the panel refresh all work. After full technical approval the banner switches to 'Commercial envelope sealed' and the technical notes become visible. One HIGH bug confirmed: the commercial opening can be locked forever (see RCA). The committee-list panel is not reachable in the live admin console.

critical.issue: Commercial opening is allowed as soon as technical_opened_at is set, even if no bid has technical_cleared_at yet. All members approve -> _open() unseals 0 bids, but notice.commercial_opened_at is still set. After that every bid is permanently sealed: re-approval -> 412 'already open', and financial-open -> 412 for sealed bids. Reproduced end to end (bids_opened=0, price stays None after technical-clear). The UI enables the 'Approve opening of commercial envelopes' button in this state.

minor.issue: Bids whose EMD is escrow-confirmed after the technical opening can never be opened (the stage is already open and there is no re-open path). This may be intended by the spec, but the UI should say so.

require_role('admin','committee_member','reviewer') means a committee member signed in under another active role (e.g. certifier, legal_counsel) gets a generic 403 instead of a hint to switch role. The committee's quorum and external invitees are ignored (all internal members are required) — fine per the spec, but quorum is now meaningless.

Sealing depends on the key prefix the client sends. A bid document whose key is not 'bid-docs/...' (e.g. a vendor-docs key attached through create/PATCH) is stored in plaintext and admin can download it before opening. Consider rejecting non-'bid-docs/' keys in BidDocument for sealed bids.

ui_bugs.issue: /admin?tab=bidding redirects to /admin/e/bidding (AdminBiddingOpsE). Its 'Active committee' card has no BidOpeningPanel. The legacy CommitteeList.jsx that renders the panel is not reachable in the live console, so the only entry point is /admin/bids/:bidId.

action_items: HIGH: in bid_opening._blockers for stage=='commercial', block (412) when no live sealed bid on the notice has technical_unsealed_at AND technical_cleared_at. Or do not set commercial_opened_at when _open opened 0 bids. Also disable the UI button in that state and show the count of tech-cleared bids.
Add BidOpeningPanel to the Active committee card in AdminBiddingOpsE (/admin/e/bidding), since the legacy CommitteeList is unreachable.
Hide or disable the 'Flag to certifier' and other stage actions in AdminBiddingOpsE while a bid's envelope_state is 'sealed' (or 'technical_open' for the accounting/committee steps).
Optional: enforce the 'bid-docs/' key prefix for bid documents in create_bid and update_bid so every envelope file is encrypted.
critical_code_review_comments: bid_opening._blockers commercial stage only checks technical_opened_at -> irreversible zero-bid commercial opening (confirmed).
redact_for_staff and bid_stage_visible take a `notice` argument that is never used (callers pass {}). Dead parameter, harmless.
uploads._may_open_sealed defaults an unknown document kind to 'technical'. Supporting docs open with technical — OK, but document it.

Other routers (comparison, bids_ai_compare, analytics, awards) read price_amount and technical_notes directly from Mongo. Those fields are None while sealed, so nothing leaks, but L1/compare will silently treat sealed bids as zero-price/flagged.

To reproduce the HIGH bug, run /tmp/probe_commercial_lock.py (may be gone): single-member committee, zero-EMD bid, approve technical, then approve commercial before technical-clear -> bids_opened 0 and locked. UI: /login, click signin-role-admin after 2.5s, committee@pmcmanagers.com/Bid@1234, then go to /admin/bids/{id}. Audit lives in db.audit_events.event_type.
rca of the issue: _blockers(n,c,'commercial') checks only n.technical_opened_at and whether the commercial stage is already open. _open() for commercial filters bids with technical_unsealed_at and technical_cleared_at, but it always sets notice.commercial_opened_at whatever the count. If the committee approves before the tender desk technically clears the qualifying bids, no bids are unsealed and the stage is marked open; the blocker 'The commercial envelopes are already open' then prevents any retry, and financial-open rejects sealed bids. Repro: notice past deadline/opening, committee {chair}, zero-EMD bid -> approve technical (1 opened) -> approve commercial (0 opened) -> technical-clear 200 -> approve commercial 412 'already open'; the bid's price stays None forever. Fix: add a blocker when the count of tech-cleared, technically unsealed bids is 0, and/or only set commercial_opened_at when count > 0 (or allow per-bid commercial unseal for bids cleared later).
